CLM-PHOT-0131.statement: The experimental pumping length L is 500 μm for each elementary channel.

extra_quotes: Grating couplers at the input facet enable selective excitation of edge modes (A1, B1, and C3), while a fan-out structure at the output facet routes the light from waveguides to individual output ports (A1, B1, C1, …, A3, B3, C3), allowing direct measurement of the field intensities after the pumping region.
Residual light appears in bulk waveguides and reduces the overall conversion efficiency
